headline: City Inspector Returns After 3 Days Missing in Hartwell Building
subheadline: Official claims 'only minutes passed'; refuses to discuss what he saw on floor 13
summary: Building inspector Harold Chen emerged from the Hartwell Building 72 hours after entering, insisting his inspection took 'maybe fifteen minutes' and showing signs of significant distress.
content:
City building inspector Harold Chen emerged from the Hartwell Building at 3:47 AM Tuesday, 72 hours after entering for what was scheduled as a routine 45-minute inspection. Chen claims he was inside for approximately fifteen minutes.

"I took the elevator to 12, walked up one flight to 14, checked the fire exits, and came back down," Chen stated in a press conference, visibly shaken and clutching a coffee cup with both hands. "I don't understand why everyone is so upset. Did something happen while I was gone?"

When informed that three full days had passed and that search parties had been mobilized, Chen became agitated. "That's not possible. I have the timestamp on my inspection form. Look - 2:15 PM, floor 12. 2:18 PM, floor 14. 2:22 PM, lobby. There's no gap."

Chen's inspection form, now in evidence, does show these timestamps. His phone, however, displays a three-day gap in all data - no calls, texts, or location history. His step counter shows 8,470 steps taken during the "fifteen-minute" inspection.

Witnesses report that Chen's hair appears "noticeably grayer" than before the inspection, and colleagues note he has developed a new habit of avoiding mirrors. When asked directly about floor 13 - the floor that officially doesn't exist - Chen terminated the press conference.

"There is no floor 13," he said, his coffee cup shaking. "The building goes 12, 14. Like most buildings that age. I don't know why you keep asking about a floor that isn't there."

Omnicorp Holdings, the building's management company, released a statement expressing relief at Chen's safe return and attributing the incident to "an unfortunate misunderstanding regarding local time zones." The building is located in a single time zone.

Chen has taken medical leave and has been seen frequenting The Underground, where he reportedly sits in the corner nursing quantum coffee and muttering about "the mirrors being doors." Owner Mars Chen (no relation) has offered him a tab and a standing reservation.

The city has quietly suspended all Hartwell Building inspections pending "equipment upgrades." When pressed on what equipment was involved, officials declined to comment.
author: Tom Hendricks, City Hall Reporter
